about: ffmpeg's own rotate and scale output for the stored source planes (yuva444p: Y, U, V, A). Each case was run as: ffmpeg -f rawvideo -pix_fmt yuva444p -s <w>x<h> -i - -vf '<filter>,format=yuva444p' -f rawvideo -, with <filter> rotate=a=<angle>:ow=<ow>:oh=<oh>:c=black@0 or scale=<ow>:<oh> (default flags: bicubic).
